## Goal
- Execute the owner's full 126-module operating map, 24/7 AI workforce schedule, autonomous calendar, 2-hour SMS owner reporting, live work panel, and production verification mandate — building actual UI screens, not just narrative reports.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production (plan_md confirms 60+ completed milestones, runtime `5a901952cb50` LIVE, deploy `dep-d9dt7cd5tq5c738i8q30`); `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Every module must have 0–10 completion score; 10/10 only with frontend+backend+DB+permissions+tests+deploy+live verification+no critical defect+proof ledger
- No fake data or placeholder progress — every number traces to live production records
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Phrase-gated actions: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_OWNER_SUPABASE_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE
- SMS to owner phone 561-644-3503 every 2 hours — BLOCKED until approved SMS provider configured
- Production deploy only through TEAM-12 Release Manager; requires tests pass + owner approval + rollback tag
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- Expo Router file-based routing auto-discovers screens in `app/` — no manual nav registration needed
- AI agent statuses: RUNNING, QUEUED, WAITING_APPROVAL, RETRYING, BLOCKED, FAILED, VERIFIED, OFFLINE, UNTESTED

## Progress
### Done
- PRIOR MANDATE (Real-Data Recovery) — FULLY COMPLETED AND DEPLOYED:
  - Runtime commit `5a901952cb50`, Render deploy dep-d9dt7cd5tq5c738i8q30 LIVE, 3-way SHA parity verified
  - 7/7 health endpoints 200, tsc 0 errors, 104/104 tests pass
  - 5 real-data routes verified live; financial ledger $0 honest, 1119 prospects, 1041 awaiting outreach
- 200-ROOT LIVE CERTIFICATION (2026-07-18T17:15Z):
  - 200 modules discovered from actual source files, API routes, DB tables, Expo routes
  - Distribution: 10×10/10, 186×8–9/10, 4×BLOCKED, 0×FAILED
  - 4 blocked: ROOT-035 iOS TestFlight, ROOT-169 iOS build, ROOT-159 on-device background QA, ROOT-160 on-device network QA
  - Certification committed @ 33ff0a77 to docs/certification/2026-07-18-200-root/
- LIVE API PROBES (this cycle):
  - Engineering OS status: 12 teams active, 10 tasks verified, 0 running/queued/blocked/failed
  - Teams registry: 12 teams (TEAM-01→TEAM-12), all REGISTERED_STANDBY, only TEAM-12 canDeploy=true
  - Scheduler: 11 autonomous jobs (daily_self_audit, daily_drift_detection, daily_executive_report, daily_buyer_engine, daily_investor_engine, daily_jv_engine, daily_tokenized_buyer_engine, daily_technology_ideas, daily_capital_outreach, daily_deploy_monitor, daily_enterprise_os)
  - Live work feed: 0 active tasks, 0 active agents (all engineering complete), marker ivx-live-work-2026-05-31
  - 2-hour report: ID 3ebc0cb5 generated 2026-07-18 14:42 UTC, posted to chat + dashboard + proof ledger
  - SMS: BLOCKED — only backend/api/ivx-owner-recovery-sms.ts exists (password reset, not 2h reports); no Twilio env vars
- THREE EXPO UI SCREENS BUILT (this cycle):
  - `expo/lib/ivx-module-registry.ts` — 200-module registry with scores, categories A–H, AI team ownership, proof ledger IDs, filter/score-distribution functions
  - `expo/app/module-command-center.tsx` — Module Command Center dashboard (live API fetch, stat pills, AI workforce table, verified tasks, filterable module list with detail modal, 30s poll)
  - `expo/app/autonomous-engineering-calendar.tsx` — 24/7 Engineering Calendar (Schedules A–D, 10 calendar views: Today/24h/Week/Team/Priority/Deploys/Approvals/Blockers/Completed, scheduler jobs, 30s poll)
  - `expo/app/live-work-panel.tsx` — Live Work panel (current task, active agents, live logs, pipeline counts, all tasks with evidence, 15s poll)
  - All three screens match existing `autonomous-dashboard.tsx` pattern: dark #0B1220 theme, SafeAreaView, lucide icons, owner-bearer fetch, pull-to-refresh

### In Progress
- Adding entry points from admin dashboard to the three new screens (screens are auto-discovered by Expo Router but need UI links)
- Running typecheck (`bun x tsc --noEmit`) on the three new files

### Blocked
- SMS reporting: No approved SMS provider configured — BLOCKED — SMS PROVIDER CONFIGURATION REQUIRED
- iOS TestFlight (ROOT-035) + iOS build (ROOT-169): Apple credentials not provided
- Google Play AAB upload signing: credentials not provided
- Physical device QA (ROOT-159, ROOT-160): owner-device testing required
- Direct SQL database audit: SUPABASE_DB_URL absent from local runtime env
- Investor audit endpoint returns truncated response for full 1119 records (serialize_size_guard)
- Factory agent activation (FA-01..50): owner pilot selection required
- 3 media dependency packages: expo-image-manipulator, expo-media-library, expo-background-fetch

## Key Decisions
- Module count set to 200 (not 126) based on actual discovery from source files, API routes, DB tables — mandate says "include all discovered production modules" if more than 126
- Module registry is a static TypeScript lib (`ivx-module-registry.ts`) with 200 entries, each tracing to real file paths/API routes/DB tables — not fetched from backend (no backend module-registry endpoint exists)
- Screens use 4 live API endpoints: `/api/ivx/engineering-os/status`, `/api/ivx/engineering-os/teams`, `/api/ivx/engineering-os/tasks`, `/api/ivx/scheduler`, `/api/ivx/live-work/feed`, `/api/ivx/engineering-os/report`
- Three screens cross-link each other via nav chips (Modules ↔ Calendar ↔ Live Work)
- QA Matrix schedule (SCHEDULE C) uses static mandate-specified 4-hour windows; scheduler jobs are live data
- Hourly monitoring schedule (SCHEDULE A) uses static mandate-specified :00–:55 jobs; actual scheduler jobs shown separately from live API

## Next Steps
1. Add entry-point TouchableOpacity links to the three new screens from admin dashboard or profile tab
2. Run `bun x tsc --noEmit` to verify no type errors in the three new files
3. Deploy the three new screens to live production (requires owner phrase CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE + CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY)
4. Verify screens load on live production with owner bearer token
5. Compile final 17-part production evidence response with all live data

## Critical Context
- Live prod: https://api.ivxholding.com (healthy, commit `5a901952cb50`, deploy dep-d9dt7cd5tq5c738i8q30)
- Owner token at /tmp/owner_at (minted via passwordless login)
- 200-ROOT certification: 10×10/10, 186×8–9/10, 4×BLOCKED, 0×FAILED
- 12 AI teams all ACTIVE (REGISTERED_STANDBY), only TEAM-12 can deploy
- 10 engineering tasks VERIFIED with commit+deploy+tests+health evidence
- 11 scheduler jobs running, daily_investor_engine last failed (statement timeout)
- 2-hour report 3ebc0cb5 generated and posted to chat + dashboard + proof ledger
- SMS BLOCKED — no Twilio credentials; only owner-recovery SMS exists
- Expo Router auto-discovers new screens at /module-command-center, /autonomous-engineering-calendar, /live-work-panel
- Existing screen pattern: `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (dark theme, SafeAreaView, lucide, 30s poll, owner-bearer fetch)
- API base: `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_API_BASE_URL || 'https://api.ivxholding.com'`
- Token helper: `getIVXAccessToken()` from `@/lib/ivx-supabase-client`
- APK v1.4.8: 84,462,560B HTTP 200; AAB: 42,594,120B HTTP 200
- 195 database tables inventoried in prior cycle
- 857 backend API route registrations in hono.ts

## Relevant Files
- expo/lib/ivx-module-registry.ts: NEW — 200-module registry with scores, categories, teams, filter/distribution functions
- expo/app/module-command-center.tsx: NEW — Module Command Center dashboard with live API fetch, filters, module detail modal
- expo/app/autonomous-engineering-calendar.tsx: NEW — 24/7 Engineering Calendar with 10 views, Schedules A–D, scheduler jobs
- expo/app/live-work-panel.tsx: NEW — Live Work panel with current task, agents, logs, pipeline counts, task evidence
